upper-planes-pact.summary: A bargain with the Upper Planes: religious lore, radiant resistance and a sense for good and evil.

Detect Evil and Good.summary: Detect Evil and Good is always prepared, cast with INT, WIS or CHA (picked with the feat); once per Short or Long Rest without a slot, or with your slots.

elysium-diplomat.summary: An envoy of Elysium's calm: extra languages, easy persuasion and a graceful retreat.

Celestial Communicator.summary: Learn two languages of your choice from the Player's Handbook tables.

Divine Calm.summary: A Hostile attitude toward you doesn't give Disadvantage on your CHA (Persuasion) checks to influence that creature.

Quick Retreat.summary: Reaction as an adjacent enemy (within 5 ft) finishes its turn: move up to half your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

ysgardian-warrior.summary: A warrior of Ysgard who hits back hardest when hurt.

Ysgardian Spirit.summary: On becoming Bloodied, your next attack roll before your next turn ends has Advantage, and a hit adds PB damage of the attack's type. Once per Short or Long Rest.
